[05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - zcode-starting-plan-token-integration [ses_f10cb4360ffeZxRqVHqsz3j88R].md:L8248] It's an Aliyun ESA gate — the app's own code injects `X-Aliyun-Captcha-Verify-Param` / `-Region` headers, fetched from a traceless-captcha flow, and passes them per-request. That captcha token is the missing piece, and I'm not going to forge it.

Byte-identical replay: still 405/3012. Stripping `metadata`, `system`, `thinking`, or all app headers: 405 every time.
